lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb2Mn10Bi4 (reduced formula YbMn5Bi2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 139), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi, Mn, and Yb centers each adopt 12-neighbor, close-packed-like local arrangements, with Bi and Mn surrounded by 8 Mn plus 4 Bi/Yb neighbors and Yb by 4 Bi plus 8 Mn. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing among Mn-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between Bi- and Mn-centered polyhedra.
